# pve_file (Data Source)

Reads a single file (ISO image, container template or import image) from a PVE storage content listing, including its size, format and creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_file" "debian_iso" {
  node         = "pve1"
  storage      = "local"
  file_name    = "debian-12.iso"
  content_type = "iso"
}

output "debian_iso" {
  value = {
    volid  = data.pve_file.debian_iso.volid
    size   = data.pve_file.debian_iso.size
    format = data.pve_file.debian_iso.format
    ctime  = data.pve_file.debian_iso.ctime
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type` (String) The storage content type of the file. Must be one of: `iso`, `vztmpl`, `import`.
- `file_name` (String) The name of the file on the storage, e.g. `debian-12.iso`. The volume is resolved by exact ID `<storage>:<content type>/<file name>`; PVE may normalize the name upstream, so use the name as it appears on the storage.
- `node` (String) The cluster node through which the storage is queried.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier holding the file.

### Read-Only

- `ctime` (Number) Creation time of the file (seconds since the UNIX epoch); null when the storage does not report it.
- `format` (String) Format identifier of the volume, e.g. `iso`, `tgz` or `raw`.
- `id` (String) The full PVE volume ID; identical to `volid`.
- `notes` (String) Optional notes attached to the volume; only the first line of multi-line notes is returned by the listing.
- `size` (Number) File size in bytes, as reported by the storage content listing; null when the storage does not report it.
- `volid` (String) The full PVE volume ID of the file, e.g. `local:iso/debian-12.iso`.
